svg.title: First match wins: how every visit picks its homepage
svg.desc: Sankey of homepage views from entry source and device through the cohort rule that fires to the homepage experience served.
svg.text: First match wins: how every visit picks its homepage
www.frescopa.coffee/ traffic, run through the cohort rules in order. Each visit gets the experience of the first rule it matches.
Flow colour = the signal that decided:
Where they came from (referrer / UTM / ad)

svg.text: Source: AEM Operational Telemetry, www.frescopa.coffee/, 30 days to 2026-11-17, 1,220 sampled views (bots and prerenders excluded).
Modelled at steady state (on-device memory is not in Optel): Has used their account before, Back with a product interest. The 10% holdout sees the original page and is not shown.
